items.title: Steve Turré interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 29, 2021
items.q: Rahsaan went into a ballad with the tenor saxophone, real breathy like a Ben Webster kind of vibe.

ctx.x: Yeah. Because he introduced me to it in person. I’d seen a few people in the movies go woooh, you know. But he had a shell. He had all kinds of things that he made sounds with you know. And he had a shell and he had it down at the side and the saxophones were on the stand and all that. Three nights went by and he didn’t play it and it was just sitting there. And I said, I said, “Rahsaan, the shell there, are you going to play that?” And he said, “I’ll play it when the time is right.” Okay. Sure. As fate would…

blown him away. But anyway Rahsaan took the shell and, with circular breathing [vocalizes], but he yelled it for like five minutes, which is a long time you know. And these people, they finally realized something was going on, this sound. And they stopped talking and went [gasps] and when they did that everybody in the club goes yaaay. You know. And then there was silence. Then there was silence and Rahsaan went into a ballad with the tenor saxophone, real breathy like a Ben Webster kind of vibe. [scats]. You…
